(V)--a son of Citraka. वा. ९६. ११४.
(I)--a class of people similar to चण्डालस्. भा. X. २४. २८.

(I)--the sacred tree under which कृष्ण is said to have sat in contemplation on the eve of his departure to Heaven.
1: भा. III. 4. 3 & 8; Br. III. ११. ३५ & १०९; १३. २९; IV. ४३. १७; वा. ३५. ३३; ९१. ४४.
Growing out of शमि tree; by attrition पुरूरवस् created fire and made it threefold for sacrificial purposes.
2: Vi. IV. 6. ८५-94.
(II)--the तीर्थ sacred to वन्दनीय. M. १३. ५१.
(III)--a follower of माया. M. १७९. ६९.
--the Bodhi tree. वा. १११. २७.

(I)--son of द्रोण and गौतमी. (कृपि- वि। प्।). Killed the sons of द्रौपदी while asleep thinking that it would please his master. Fought with Arjuna, was defeated and taken prisoner. Roused द्रौपदी's pity in that state and was released after being deprived of his crown and hair.
1: भा. I. 7. १४-52; Vi. IV. १९. ६८.
Hit the infant in the womb of Uttara with ब्रह्मशिरस्। कृष्ण's protection of परीक्षित् in the womb from अश्वथामन्'s arrow, and of Arjuna from अश्वथा- man's arrows.
2: भा. I. 8. १२; १२. 1; १५. १६; १६. १५.
Destroyed the Kurus by his ब्रह्मास्त्र।
3: भा. IX. २२. ३४.
In Duryodhana's army. Survived कुरुक्षेत्र war.
4: भा. X. ७८. [९५. (V) १६]; ८०[2].
A sage of the first epoch of शावर्ण Manu
5: वा. १००. १२; M. 9. ३२.
hurled ब्रह्मास्त्र when परीक्षित् was in his mother's womb.
6: Vi. IV. २०. ५२.
(II)--(द्रोणपुत्र) becomes a sage of the 8th manvantara. भा. VIII. १३. १५. [page१-127+ ३५]
(III)--a son of अश्विनी and अक्रूर. M. ४५. ३२.
--the king of Madras; issueless sacrificed to goddess सावित्री and was blessed with a daughter of that name. M. २०८. 5-११.
--a दानव. Br. III. 6. १५.
--a son of Citraka. वा. ९६. ११३.
--a horse-faced image on the figure of God of Love. M. २६१. ५३.

--Thrice performed by युधिष्ठिर.
1: भा. I. 8. 6; १०. 2. [1]; १२. ३४.
One hundred performed by Bali;
2: Ib. VIII. १५. ३४.
of अम्बरीष where वसिष्ठ and Gautama were present.
3: Ib. IX. 4. २२.
Thrice performed by परीक्षित्.
4: Ib. I. १६. 3.
Performed by अङ्ग when gods did not respond to his call.
5: Ib. IV. १३. २५.
A hundred were performed by पृथु. But in the last Indra stole away the horse.
6: Ib. IV. १६. २४; १९, 1.
Performed by Indra.
7: Ib. VI. १३. १८-20; Br. II. ३०. १०; M. १४३. 6-२६.
Per- formed by कृष्ण at द्वारका. The sacrificial horse was sent out with a number of warriors to watch its course. All [page१-128+ ४०] kings including the पाण्डवस् attended the sacrifice. In the course of the sacrifice a ब्राह्मण complained of the death of his children immediately after birth. At this Arjuna (s.v.) offered to give succour and recovered them with कृष्ण's aid, from नारायण's abode. नारायण said that he took the children as a means to see कृष्ण and Arjuna in their human form. The अवभृत of the sacrifice was cele- brated in the यमुना.
8: भा. X. ८९. २२-64.
A remedy for brahmicide.
9: Ib. VI. १३. 6-9.
Per- formed by शूद्र kings in Kali age;

of other kings;

equal to going to गया, bath in the प्रयाग and Ganges, कोटिहोम, ग्रहबलि, etc.

१०० of them performed by Somadatta;

--the performer of it, becomes राजराज. M. १०१. ७१.

(II)--a follower of Bali. M. २४५. ३१.
--married Sutanu; father of Vajra. वा. ९६. २५१.

--a son of Citraka. Br. III. ७१. ११५.
(I)--the wife of अक्रूर, and mother of thirteen sons. M. ४५. ३२-3.

--the gods of Vaivasvata epoch; sons of बदवा (सम्ज्ञा) and Vivasvat born through the nose and hence नासत्यस्;
1: भा. VIII. १३. 4, १०; Br. III. ५९. ७४-76; M. 9. २९; ११. ३५-7; २५. ४३; Vi. I. 9. ६४; III. 2. 7; वा. ८४. २३-24,
fought with वृषपर्व in देवासुर war.
2: भा. VIII. १०. ३०.
Were taught the अश्वसिरस् मन्त्र by the sage दध्यङ्ग.
3: Ib. VI. 9. ५२; १०. १७.
Called on Cyavana. Being physicians they could not parti- cipate in सोम। Cyavana offered a share in सोम to them if they could give him a youthful form. He was made to look exactly like themselves so much so that सुकन्या was not able to distinguish her husband. On a prayer the [page१-131+ ५७] अश्विन्स् showed सुकन्या her lord and departed.
4: भा. IX. 3. ११-17. वा. १०. ७१; ३०. ८४; ३९. ४९.
In the यज्ञ of शर्याति, were allowed to partake of सोम juice.
5: भा. IX. 3. २४-26.
Parents of Nakula and Sahadeva through पाण्डु's queen माद्री.
6: Ib. IX. २२. २८; M. ४६. १०; ५०. ५०; Vi. IV. २०. ४०.

wor- shipped for long life;
8: भा. II. 3. 5.
form the nose of पुरुष;

guard medi- cinal herbs in Candra hill of प्लक्ष for nectar;

११: Br. III. 1. ५७; 7. २५४.

१२: Ib. III. ३५. ५७.

१३: M. १४८. ८६, ९७.
Also अश्वि- कुमारकौ; worship of, in the ग्रहबलि।

the two forefeet of the शिशुमार (porpoise);

stood on गयासुर, along with other gods;
१८: वा. १०६. ५९.
presented their weapons on the occasion of the marriage of शिव with ललिता to the divine couple;
१९: Br. IV. १५. २४.
